data_origin: Official NCAA records; no generated business data
scope: Main school table: ordinary Division I home games only; reclassifying rows separate. History: Division I all-games as printed.

source_issues.detail: The reported 359-team home summary includes 59 games / 22,766 attendance from four separately listed reclassifying teams. Main school KPIs exclude those rows; official summary is retained separately.
source_issues.resolution: Exact difference reconciles to all four reclassifying rows; do not silently mix scopes.

source_issues.detail: Historical table reports average 1,846 and total 10,500,879; the summary comparison implies average 1,901 and total 10,501,304.
source_issues.resolution: Retain historical values as printed and flag them. Do not use this series for the forecast or claim the conflicting values are corrected.

source_issues.detail: Official school means may round or truncate; recompute attendance/home_games for analytic ranking.
source_issues.resolution: Keep both computed and printed values; require difference <= 1.01 attendee.
